Subject: Go-live rally: confirm final cutover & fallback owners

Hi Sarah / Rajesh —

We're targeting the final go-live cutover for Acme on Thursday, June 3rd (target window: 02:00–05:00 UTC). Before we lock the calendar we'd like to run a 60-minute "go-live rally" to align owners, confirm fallback policies, and walk through the runbook. Proposed agenda (45 min + 15 min buffer):

- 0–5m: roll call + objective
- 5–20m: cutover steps and ownership (deployment, DB migration, traffic switch)
- 20–35m: fallback & rollback triggers + who pulls the cord
- 35–45m: comms plan and escalation chain (ops + execs)
- 45–60m: Q&A and open action items

Proposed times (all times in UTC):
- Option A: Wed, 26 May | 15:00–16:00 UTC
- Option B: Thu, 27 May | 21:00–22:00 UTC (better for APAC participants)
- Option C: Fri, 28 May | 09:00–10:00 UTC

Please reply with preferred option and any hard constraints. Required attendees: Acme Eng Lead (Sarah), Acme Platform Ops (Rajesh), Acme Procurement / InfoSec rep, Redwood SE (Marcus), Redwood AE (me), Redwood Cutover Lead (Karthik), Redwood CS (Monica).

Attached: draft runbook (high level) and a proposed fallback-owners matrix. If you want a longer dry-run we can schedule a tabletop separately.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_go-live-draft-runbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: fallback-owners-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the runbook — looks good at a glance. Procurement and InfoSec flagged a couple of constraints we need to respect: procurement needs to review final commercial terms before the runbook is finalized, and InfoSec (cc'd) needs a short SOC2 summary and KMS integration notes before the cutover.

On timing: our engineering leadership is blocked most mornings next week due to roadmap demos. Option A (26 May 15:00 UTC) is OK for Eng, but procurement can only join Option C (28 May 09:00 UTC) or later. Could we aim for Option C and shift the agenda earlier in the day for Acme?

Also, Rajesh asked whether we can add a short 10-minute pre-call for a security sync if InfoSec needs it. Happy to coordinate.

Cheers,
Sarah

- Cutover lead: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — overall decision authority for go/no-go

Procurement here. We can make the Fri 28 May 09:00 UTC slot work. A couple items to confirm before the rally:
